cross_cutting_substrate_decisions_to_pre.compliance_audit_chain: Every state transition emits oya.<µservice>.<capability> sealed events. Per ADR-0162 per-tenant slicing. Per ADR-0123 T2 decisions log full provenance. Applies to procurement, inventory, asset-lifecycle, contracts, expense — all of them.
cross_cutting_substrate_decisions_to_pre.cross_system_orchestration: Direct peer calls forbidden. All cross-µservice work flows through workflow-engine + ontology projections. Applies to every product spun out of the aborted framing.
cross_cutting_substrate_decisions_to_pre.stack_policy: In-house only per master-plan-sequencing.json#in_house_stack_policy. Postgres + Citus, Valkey, Kafka, OpenSearch, Cedar, OpenSLO, OpenBao, Mimir/Grafana — all LTS-pinned.
cross_cutting_substrate_decisions_to_pre.mobile_fast_path_doctrine: Approval flows must be ≤ 3 taps mobile for typical-value transactions. Applies to procurement, expense, contract approvals.

anti_patterns_to_carry_forward.refusal: No admin-army-required + per-customer customization as the product. Configuration is declarative + versioned + audit-chained.
Mobile-first ≤ 3-tap approval. No 10-step approval before PO.
Setup ≤ 1 sprint per tenant; mobile primary, not afterthought.
Standalone run; FHIR adapter optional; no vendor clinical data coupling.
No HR/finance master-data lock-in; project to ontology.
Own workflow, not the editor. Redline + signature go to drive + docs + pluggable e-sign.
No GPO lock-in; pluggable wholesaler adapters.
Surface metrics into workflow; not a standalone reporting silo.
